summary.text: Luis Viera is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 67 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Lisette Bonano; the Democratic primary was canceled.
He is a member of the Tampa City Council, representing District 7, and assumed that office on December 8, 2016.

paragraphs.text: Luis Viera has represented District 7 on the Tampa City Council since December 8, 2016, and his current term ends on May 1, 2027, according to Ballotpedia.
